messages:
marta: FYI security scanner flagged a Python dependency vuln that affects tokenizers and may cascade into transformers. CI started failing on master after a poetry lock regenerate. need quick triage.
kevin: which CVE id? and is it a direct dep or transitive?
marta: scanner shows CVE-2026-1234, matched to tokenizers <0.14.2. looks like an archive-extraction path; transitive for some infra tools but tokenizers is direct in a couple services.
carla: severity from NVD?
sec-bot: CVE-2026-1234, CVSS 7.1 (High). Exploit category: unsafe archive extraction. Public PoC: none confirmed but recommended patch exists.
sam: CI log snippet: ```
ERROR tests/test_pipeline.py::test_fastpath - FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'tokenizers-0.13.5.tar.gz'
Action: poetry lock failed while resolving binary wheel for tokenizers
```
kevin: ok. two actions: (1) hotpatch to unblock prod and CI (pin/constraints), (2) schedule full lockfile regen and verification for next maintenance window.
marta: agree. hotpatch candidate: add a pip/constraints or update pyproject to allow tokenizers==0.14.2 and regenerate lock only for that package. keep regen minimal to avoid cascade.
carla: +1. we should also add a GH action that enforces a constraints file for deploys until we do full regen.
kevin: I'll open a draft PR now: will add constraints.txt and a minimal poetry lock update for tokenizers. will run all unit + integration tests in CI.
kevin: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/patch/tokenizers-hotpatch (draft)
marta: good. also check wheels for manylinux tags. if we pin, ensure the wheel is available for our dedicated GPU images.
sam: checked — 0.14.2 has manylinux wheels for py39/py310.
carla: we need a short security blurb for customers if this impacts hosted inference (likely not, but be safe). create triage note after we confirm deploy status.
sec-bot: Recommended mitigations: pin to patched version, add CI-level constraints, run SCA scanner post-patch, create backport PR for 2.3 branch if present.
kevin: assign self to hotpatch, will target merge within 2 hours if CI passes. leaving note to backport to release/2.3 and create ticket INF-4567 for full lock regen.
marta: for audit/KMS concerns — any evidence of key usage or exfil in logs?
sam: checked CloudTrail & audit logs for last 30 days — no anomalous KMS Decrypt/External activity tied to this package. no alerts.
carla: rolling plan: hotpatch -> smoke on staging -> monitor logs 24h -> promote. if any test flakes, revert constraints and escalate.
kevin: patch opened, CI kicked off. small ask: devops, if the hotpatch touches docker build, please prioritize the image rebuild in internal pipeline. @devops-bot can you kick a rebuild?
devops-bot: manual rebuild queued: job #788. ETA ~20m.
marta: thanks. once merged, I'll draft the short customer-facing note and post to #incidents if we decide outreach needed.
kevin: CI green on unit tests, one flaky integration failing (timeout). rerunning full suite.
kevin: CI finally green. merging now. :thumbsup:
carla: great. create follow-up PR for full poetry lock regen and run the longer compatibility matrix (py38-310) — target later this week.
sec-bot: closing triage: status = hotpatched -> monitoring. tags: tokenizers, transformers, poetry, constraints, backport.
marta: thanks everyone, assigning INF-4567 to kevin for the follow-up. will update the security tracker.
